basis: Illustrative low-power demonstration loads. The assumed loads and 75% preliminary fuse loading factor require confirmation against the selected part, wiring, source and ambient conditions.
release_conditions: Actual continuous and startup currents do not exceed the design assumptions.
Source rail, combined-power and return-path ratings support simultaneous loads.
Every wire, holder, terminal and connector is protected by the chosen time-current curve and fault-clearing energy.
The exact fuse part has a documented DC voltage rating and adequate DC breaking capacity for the prospective fault current.
Temperature derating, physical dimensions and holder compatibility are checked.
Installed fuse markings and application tests are recorded before releasing a hardware current rating.
wiring_basis: F1–F3 serve fixed terminals. F4 represents the adjustable-section holder on the OUT+ path, following the team description. The original fan is internal to the PSU. Green uses +5VSB and red uses PWR_OK through 1 kohm.

adjustable_fuse.location_in_model: U1 OUT+ to J6 positive terminal
adjustable_fuse.basis: Team description and lower panel holder photograph
